# Dirgha

> Open-source agent harness for software and robots, by Dirgha AI. Runs a coding agent and MuJoCo robot simulations on your own machine, with any model provider or local models, and checks every action with a fail-closed safety gate before it runs. Apache-2.0.

Dirgha has two parts behind one command: a TypeScript coding agent and a Rust kernel (`dirgha-native-host`, about 1 MB) that serves 24 MCP tools over stdio. Six robotics and hardware tools are demos and return `"simulated": true`. Full rules for teams live in LOKAHI.

## Start here
- [README](https://github.com/Dirgha-AI/dirgha/blob/main/README.md): what Dirgha is, install, commands, safety model, status
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Dirgha-AI/dirgha/blob/main/AGENTS.md): build, test and change rules for AI agents working on the code
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Dirgha-AI/dirgha/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release notes

## Related
- [LOKAHI](https://github.com/Dirgha-AI/lokahi): open rules format and gate for agent actions (`pip install lokahi`)
- [Arniko](https://github.com/Dirgha-AI/arniko): security scanner for AI agent code
- [Ahimsa AI](https://github.com/Dirgha-AI/ahimsa-ai): impact assessment that compiles to rules
